o1: Enables G-protein alpha-subunit binding activity, GDP-dissociation inhibitor activity, and G protein regulator activity; predicted to enable GTPase regulator activity. Predicted to be involved in cell division. Is involved in the establishment of spindle orientation, asymmetric cell division, mitotic spindle positioning, and cytokinesis. Is located in the cell cortex and microtubule aster. Is part of the G-protein signaling pathway; the heterotrimeric G-protein signaling pathway; and the G protein pathway. Is expressed in P lineage cell.
